description: The Bureau: a public page for any ERC-8004 agent id on Robinhood Chain, with only lines that can be proven. Says whether the id exists, whether it has a separate agent wallet, the feedback others left on the reputation registry, the owner's Hookr Agent gate status, and, if the id is a declared Tokyo agent, its Agent Record counts. Warns when the owner wallet holds 20 or more ids (a factory, not one agent per id). No wallet address is shown. Read only, free.
name: bureau_agent
